is_anopheles.evidence: The study investigates salmon lice (Lepeophtheirus salmonis), an ectoparasitic copepod of salmon (page 133).

reports_target_markers.evidence: No Anopheles insecticide resistance target markers were examined; the study focuses on transcriptomic responses and candidate genes related to emamectin benzoate resistance in salmon lice.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No genotype or allele frequencies/counts for any target resistance markers are reported.

african_field_population.evidence: Samples were collected from salmon farms in British Columbia and New Brunswick, Canada (page 135).

is_primary_study.evidence: The study reports original primary transcriptomic and RT-qPCR data on salmon lice exposed to emamectin benzoate.

sub_country_location.evidence: Collections occurred near Campbell River, British Columbia, and Back Bay / Grand Manan, New Brunswick, Canada (page 135).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Pacific lice were collected in March 2009 and Atlantic lice were collected in 2012 (page 135).

duplicate_risk.evidence: Not applicable to African Anopheles surveillance networks.

supplement.evidence: The study does not contain data on Anopheles or relevant insecticide resistance markers.

assessment.summary: This study examines transcriptomic responses and expression differences linked to emamectin benzoate resistance in salmon lice (Lepeophtheirus salmonis) in Canada. It does not study Anopheles or mosquito resistance markers.
